import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun b s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem req_normal_order_routed : NormalOrderRouted step := sorry
theorem req_routes_available    : RoutesAvailable step := sorry
theorem req_never_overroute     : NeverOverroute step := sorry
theorem req_stop_when_filled    : StopWhenFilled step := sorry
theorem req_no_excess_execution : NoExcessExecution step := sorry
theorem req_fill_accounting     : FillAccounting step := sorry

end OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun b s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

  let p := s.parents id

namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun b s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

theorem plan0_inv_advance_route_aux : ∀ (b : Build) (x : Sys) (id liq : Nat),
    Inv x → Inv (advance step b x (.route id liq)) := by
  intro b x id liq hx
  obtain ⟨hNp, hQty, hSent, hNch, hPar, hLe⟩ := hx
  -- unfold advance for route
  have hstep : ∀ (b : Build) (s : State) (id liq : Nat), step b s (.route id liq) = routeBySent s id liq := by
    intro b s id liq; rfl
  have hobs : x.tr.observe (.route id liq) = x.tr := rfl
  -- condition
  set p := x.st.parents id with hp
  set c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent) with hc
  have hcond_dec : Decidable (id < x.st.nParents ∧ 0 < c) := instDecidableAnd
  by_cases hcond : id < x.st.nParents ∧ 0 < c
  · -- true branch: state updates, one child sent
    have hRb : routeBySent x.st id liq =
      ({ x.st with parents := upd x.st.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
                  nChildren := x.st.nChildren + 1,
                  children := upd x.st.children x.st.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩]) := by
      unfold routeBySent
      simp only [hp, hc] at *
      simp [hcond]
    have hst1 : (step b x.st (.route id liq)).1 =
      ({ x.st with parents := upd x.st.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
                  nChildren := x.st.nChildren + 1,
                  children := upd x.st.children x.st.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ } : State) := by
      rw [hstep]; rw [hRb]
    have hst2 : (step b x.st (.route id liq)).2 = [⟨id, c⟩] := by
      rw [hstep]; rw [hRb]
    have hadv_st : (advance step b x (.route id liq)).st =
      ({ x.st with parents := upd x.st.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
                  nChildren := x.st.nChildren + 1,
                  children := upd x.st.children x.st.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ } : State) := by
      simp only [advance, hst1]
    have hadv_tr : (advance step b x (.route id liq)).tr =
      x.tr.record [⟨id, c⟩] := by
      simp only [advance, hobs, hst2]

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

  match e with

    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])

import OrderRouter.Spec
import OrderRouter.Lemmas
import ProofForgeFin.Trading.RouterModel
namespace OrderRouter

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun b s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

import OrderRouter.Spec

/-- Regular and RLP paths: send the available liquidity capped at the shares not yet sent. -/
def routeBySent (s : State) (id liq : Nat) : State × List Child :=
  let p := s.parents id
  let c := min liq (p.qty - p.sent)
  if id < s.nParents ∧ 0 < c then
    ({ s with parents := upd s.parents id { p with sent := p.sent + c },
              nChildren := s.nChildren + 1,
              children := upd s.children s.nChildren ⟨id, c, 0⟩ }, [⟨id, c⟩])
  else (s, [])

def step : Impl := fun b s e =>
  match e with
  | .parent q f =>
    ({ s with nParents := s.nParents + 1, parents := upd s.parents s.nParents ⟨q, f, 0, 0⟩ }, [])
  | .route id liq => routeBySent s id liq
  | .ack _ => (s, [])
  | .fill k q =>
    if k < s.nChildren then
      let c := s.children k
      let x := min q (c.qty - c.done)
      let p := s.parents c.parent
      let p' := ({ p with cum := p.cum + x } : ParentRec)
      ({ s with parents := upd s.parents c.parent p',
                children := upd s.children k { c with done := c.done + x } }, [])
    else (s, [])

(1) **Proof plan.** Split `InvFull (advance step b x (.fill k q))` into its seven components. A fill changes neither parent/child counts, quantities, nor sent amounts, and does not create kids, giving the first helper. On the truth side, a fill adds exactly `min q (c.qty - c.done)` to the executed total of child `k`'s parent (or nothing if `k` is unknown); on the state side, `step` adds the same amount to that parent's `cum`. The invariant's child correspondence identifies the state's child `k` with the truth's child `k` (using `nChildren = kids.length`), so those two increments coincide, yielding the `cum` component. Finally, the truth updates `kids` by `List.set k` with the increased `done`, while the state updates `children` by `upd` at the same index with the same increase; case-splitting on `idx = k` versus `idx ≠ k`, and on `k` being in range, yields the child-correspondence component. Assembling these pieces gives `InvFull` after a fill.
